events.title: Number Machine + Zachtronics = Bundle 👏
events.summary: Hello!I'm very happy to announce that Number Machine will be bundled at launch with two classic Zachtronics games that directly inspired it: Opus Magnum and Infinifactory. All three games will also be discounted at the launch of Number Machine.The similarities to Opus Magnum are obvious, but the satisfying gameplay of Infinifactory was also a major source of inspiration. Both of these are my personal top factory games. Special thanks to Zach Barth of Zachtronics for making this possible.Cheers f

events.title: DEMO IS OUT NOW! 👀
events.summary: Hello!I'm happy to inform you that the demo for Number Machine is out right now. Yes, you can open it and take it for a spin! In the demo you will find:Mini campaign with 10 levels.A bunch of beginner tutorial levels and a few more open ended harder ones.Histograms, world records and friend scores. All fully server side verified!Full controller support for the couch homies.Have feedback? Feel free to post in the Steam discussions or on the official Discord channel.Thank you, - Ariel

events.title: Demo, Release, Bundles and Fests
events.summary: Hello! I've been working a lot lately to get Number Machine into your fingers and I've got a bunch of news to share about my upcoming colorful nerdy factory game. DemoYou can expect the demo to be released around the end of this month, September 2026. It'll have a mini campaign with fully server side verified online highscores, for each level as well as the campaign as a whole. ReleaseThe game will fully release on November 6th 2026 with a 2 week discount. I'm really excited (and nervous) to pub
